unresolved_should_improve.claim: Both drafts cut two things from source para 20. One is the Minister's reply that the ships be stopped by political power. The other is Russell's detention 'on the ground urged by the American Minister'. Para 19 then calls the detention a 'sudden leap to his opponent's ground' without saying what that ground was.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The Solicitor General's 'policy though not of strict law' survives and hints at the shift.

evidence.quote: Minister Adams replied that, in this case, the statute should be amended, or the ships stopped by exercise of the political power.

This sudden leap to his opponent's ground might have roused Palmerston to inhuman scorn

Both drafts also omit the Minister's earlier attack, so 'the notes' has no antecedent.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The rhetorical sense of 'had no secretaries' is recoverable from context.

The Secretary, the Assistant Secretary, and the private secretary did all the work that the Minister did not do.
